title: HyperPerformance
description: The only modpack you will ever need for a smooth and comfortable gameplay!
body:
Have you ever played vanilla Minecraft and felt sad because of lacking FPS and helpful mods? If yes, then this modpack is for you! It includes a lot of optimization mods for a smooth gameplay and some mods that make your gameplay even better but still server-legal!
If you would like to give me some suggestions, you can mail them to **hyperperformancemc@gmail.com**
